Not even to his sister.

pregnant-and-divorced-by-my-disabled-hus:

Looking at the adorable child who seemed like a spitting image of his son, his face turned pale.
“Why do you look exactly the same?”
The little one replied, “Biologically, only identical twins look exactly the same.”
